notes.title: The update is here!
notes.notes:
Our Major Fire Commander update is now live! 

[previewyoutube=MrYq1xU12nI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]This update includes:[/b]

[list][*]Major AI improvements
[*]Pathfinding changes (for both firefighters and vehicles)
[*]Balancing adjustments and optimisations 
[*]Minor and major bug fixes[/list]

[b]The bug fixes include key fixes such as:[/b]

[list][*]Fire damage no longer stops before reaching 100%
[*]All fires can now be extinguished
[*]Fire no longer spreads through walls
[*]Doors can no longer be broken through walls
[*]Firefighters no longer refuse to extinguish certain fires[/list]

And other minor tweaks and changes.

Update your game for free and experience Fire Commander in an improved way!

notes.title: Changelog pt. 1
notes.notes:
Hello, Heroes!

It’s been a busy one week since the premiere. You’ve spoken and we’re patching! Here’s a list of fixes already implemented in the game:

[list][*]Fixed mission descriptions in the Fire Station
[*]Fixed the game save while escorting an unconscious victim
[*]Added support for AZERTY keyboard
[*]Fixed achievements
[*]Fixed hitboxes of incident reports on the map
[*]Special action in the Shopping Mall mission has been changed from helicopter to airplane
[*]Missions Railway and Railway2 now have different descriptions in the Dispatch Room
[*]Parachute units no longer disappear after the game is loaded[/list]

More is coming so stay tuned!

notes.title: Lust from Beyond: M Edition Demo available now + game release date
notes.notes:
Hello there!

We bring you thrilling news from our friends at Movie Games. Their demo for Lust from Beyond: M Edition, a first-person Lovecraftian horror is now available! Check it out, David Jaffe himself gave it a high praise.

[previewyoutube=NBSNPvt-vJQ;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NBSNPvt-vJQ&ab_channel=MovieGamesS.A. [/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1641890/Lust_from_Beyond_M_Edition 

The full game will be released on the 10th of February 2022. Add it to your wishlist to keep it on your radar!
